reviews.title: Decent tarpaulin for outdoor activities
reviews.body: TLDR;  A good waterproof tarp option for outdoor activities, solid reinforcement on seams and attachments, too few stakes, poor stake quality, loose threads, price may be a bit high.The tarp itself appears to be of decent quality, with solid reinforcement at the seams and attachment points (+).  In several water tests, the tarp appears to be water proof (+).  The only issue I have with the tarp is the several long threads around the edges (photo).  Easy enough to deal with, but I would expect a bit more quality control (-).The included stakes (photo) are extremely lightweight (0.425 oz / ~12g each) and do not appear to be high quality (-).  Attempting to use them in U.S Western clay (Caliche) immediately begins to bend them.  In addition, most scenarios will require more than 4.  I switched them out for 8 titanium alloy stakes. which work well in our ground conditions.  The included cordage and sack are a nice addition (+).
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 12, 2024

reviews.title: Seems quality made
reviews.body: Very well made with tons of tie-down points. Material feels adequately thick without being heavy. Questionable about being totally waterproof because none of these tarps rarely are waterproof. Will edit the review if I find it leaks. Stakes are very lightweight but seem sturdy enough but rough pounding will bend them if you're not careful. Only included 4 but there should be at least 6 included. Paracord and stuff sack are a nice added touch. Good that the tie-down points are reinforced.

reviews.title: Versatile tarp that handles everything you throw at it
reviews.body: This FREE SOLDIER waterproof tarp has been an essential part of my camping gear. The multifunctional design means I can set it up as a rain shelter, sun shade, ground cover, or windbreak depending on what I need. The versatility alone makes it worth having.The waterproof coating actually works—I've been through some serious downpours and stayed completely dry underneath. No leaking or seeping even in heavy rain. The material is tough and durable, holding up well to rough use and being staked out in windy conditions.The size is generous enough to provide real coverage but packs down compact enough for easy transport. The reinforced grommets are solid and haven't shown any signs of tearing out, even with tension from guy lines in wind. Setup is quick and straightforward with multiple configuration options.The portability is excellent—it folds up small and doesn't add much weight to my gear. Perfect for camping, hiking, or keeping in the vehicle for emergency use.Whether you're setting up a cooking area, creating shelter, or just need reliable weather protection, this tarp delivers. Quality construction that actually performs in real outdoor conditions.Highly recommend for any outdoor enthusiast!

reviews.title: Great on my rainy camping trip
reviews.body: I'm very happy with this. I bought it right before a campout and it rained a lot. I was able to string it up really well among three trees and a random tree branch. I didn't rely on the included spikes so I can't speak for those. But it is really lightweight it seems really durable and it folds up reasonably small.There are lots of points to attach ropes so that makes it especially easy to work with.Recommended
